name: high_temp_heat_pump_zeotropic_transcritical
title: High-temperature heat pump: zeotropic/transcritical cycle (R1336mzz(Z))
summary: High-temperature heat pump of squoilin/NextGenerationHeatPumps on imposed cycle pressures (default run transcritical: 32 bar over the 29.04 bar critical pressure of R1336mzz(Z)), constant isentropic efficiency, and both secondary water loops recalculated from an imposed pinch (their capacity flow rates are the unknowns).

origin.course: nghp/advanced HTHP model.py (commit 6db23af4dbad2098043a74d1871dbcc6f8eee468); REFPROP back end replaced by CoolProp (decision D12)

verification.summary: The original script was re-run in a throw-away venv (CoolProp 8.0.0, HEOS instead of REFPROP, headless) with the variant's fluid and pressures; the _coolsolve variant agrees with its printed state tables, mass flow, COP, water outlet temperatures and capacity flow rates to 7.9e-08 (states 3e-11). The native file does not run: R1336mzz(Z) is missing from the CoolSolve fluid registry.
verification.reference: nghp/advanced HTHP model.py (commit 6db23af) re-run in a venv, R365mfc at p_low = 8 bar / p_high = 32 bar (the variant operating point) and R1336mzz(Z) at 10.5/32 bar (the native default run, for the reference numbers in the README)
verification.notes: Same CoolProp equation of state on both sides (8.1.0dev in the CoolSolve build, 8.0.0 in the venv); the reference only prints 4-6 digits, which bounds the largest deviations (C_dot_hf, T_hf_ex).
